name: Gooey Switch
description: A neutral liquid switch with a circular ivory thumb and optional elastic dragging.

settings.label: Accessible name
settings.description: Name announced by assistive technology. Whitespace-only names reset to Toggle setting.

settings.label: On
settings.description: Sets the logical switch state without emitting a user action.

settings.label: Disabled
settings.description: Blocks pointer and keyboard activation while still accepting external state updates.

settings.label: Width
settings.description: Requested width in pixels. Height stays half the width; narrow hosts scale the complete drawing.

settings.label: Track top
settings.description: Upper stop of the recessed track gradient.

settings.label: Track bottom
settings.description: Lower stop of the recessed track gradient.

settings.label: Track edge
settings.description: Fine track edge; the focus outline remains independent.

settings.label: Liquid
settings.description: Color of every liquid shape and settled fill.

settings.label: Shadow strength
settings.description: Scales contact and ambient shadow opacity. Zero removes both.

settings.label: Interaction
settings.description: Drag or click enables continuous thumb scrubbing. Keyboard remains available in both modes.

settings.label: Liquid timing
settings.description: Scales the liquid and thumb motion together. The spring may finish slightly later.

settings.label: Spring damping
settings.description: Higher values suppress recoil; lower values make the thumb more elastic.

settings.label: Elastic stretch
settings.description: Horizontal thumb stretch with gentle vertical compression. Higher stretch starts the thumb sooner; zero keeps the original circle and timing.

settings.label: Edge resistance
settings.description: Drag mode only. Smaller values admit less pointer travel beyond either end.

rights.attribution: Original rendered Gooey Switch artwork by Cameron Rickerby, independently authored procedural SVG; captured from the working component.

motion.reducedMotion: Snap to the current logical endpoint; no decorative travel or deformation.
